newsitem.title: ITALY: New Alfa "156" set for launch in October.
newsitem.headline: New Alfa "156" set for launch in October.

text.p: Italian car company Alfa Romeo, owned by the Fiat SpA group, said on Wednesday that it would launch for sale a new Alfa Romeo "156" to replace its old "155" model in October this year.

The new medium-large saloon Alfa will be available with a choice of four petrol engines and two diesel versions. Of the petrol engines there will be three twin spark 16 valve types of 1.6 litre, 1.8 litre and 2 litre capacity, and a further 2.5 litre V6 24 valve engine, the company said in a statement.
Of the diesel engines, there will be a four cylinder 1.9 litre and a five cylinder 2.4 litre engine types.
